svg.title: The Arbitrage Scale Ladder
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-arbitrage-scale-ladder; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: The Arbitrage Scale Ladder; subtitle: Peak portfolios, delegated growth, and per-building density; caption: Reported portfolio sizes from two scaled operators, narrowing from Humza Zafar's 450-unit peak to Richie Matthews' average of 6 units per building.; assumptions note: Each stage is a separately reported operator figure, not a single cohort converting through stages. Unit counts are attributed practitioner claims.; note: Humza Zafar (1D3J3ID1ZZM) reported the 450 peak and 300 trim; Richie Matthews (VtVf0h80q0w, O4cBKKUBS64) reported 18 to 35 units in 6 months and the $2,000 to $2,500 minimum net per property.; stages: label: Peak portfolio (Humza Zafar); value: 450; display: 450 units; conversion: Peak; detail: Economy units died to competition; stacking units in Detroit cost about $100K in cannibalization.; label: Trimmed A-class portfolio; value: 300; display: 300 units; conversion: 450 cut back to 300; detail: Shifted to A-class because fixed costs are identical across classes; cleared 0% APR cards before they reset.; label: Delegated portfolio (Richie Matthews); value: 35; display: 35 units; conversion: 18 to 35 in 6 months; detail: An $80-a-month Hospitable plus dynamic pricing stack and 900 VA protocols after delegating operations.; label: Pre-delegation portfolio; value: 18; display: 18 units; conversion: Baseline before the March 2021 system build; detail: You can't scale chaos (Richie Matthews).; label: Average units per building; value: 6; display: 6 units; conversion: Per-building density; detail: Any property not netting at least $2,000 to $2,500 per month gets dropped or renegotiated.

rect.title: label: Peak portfolio (Humza Zafar); value: 450; display: 450 units; conversion: Peak; detail: Economy units died to competition; stacking units in Detroit cost about $100K in cannibalization.

label: Trimmed A-class portfolio; value: 300; display: 300 units; conversion: 450 cut back to 300; detail: Shifted to A-class because fixed costs are identical across classes; cleared 0% APR cards before they reset.

label: Delegated portfolio (Richie Matthews); value: 35; display: 35 units; conversion: 18 to 35 in 6 months; detail: An $80-a-month Hospitable plus dynamic pricing stack and 900 VA protocols after delegating operations.
label: Pre-delegation portfolio; value: 18; display: 18 units; conversion: Baseline before the March 2021 system build; detail: You can't scale chaos (Richie Matthews).
label: Average units per building; value: 6; display: 6 units; conversion: Per-building density; detail: Any property not netting at least $2,000 to $2,500 per month gets dropped or renegotiated.

text.title: Assumptions: Each stage is a separately reported operator figure, not a single cohort converting through stages. Unit counts are attributed practitioner claims.
